# Storage properties

Properties of `rclone-backup` storages in `/etc/pve/storage.cfg`. `pve-rclone-backup storage init` sets them when it adds a storage. Change them with `pve-rclone-backup storage set <storage> <property>=<value>` or `pvesm set <storage> --<property> <value>`, and reset one to its default with `pvesm set <storage> --delete <property>`. The daemon picks up changes on its own. [Storages](../guide/storages.md) explains how to use them.

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`rclone-remote`](#rclone-remote) | none | Name of the transport remote configured with 'pve-rclone-backup remote add'. |
| [`rclone-path`](#rclone-path) | `pve-backups` | Repository base path inside the remote: folder names separated by "/", of letters, digits, spaces, ".", "_" and "-", each starting with a letter or digit and not ending with a space. |
| [`rclone-encryption`](#rclone-encryption) | `crypt` | Client-side encryption of the repository (rclone crypt). |
| [`rclone-source`](#rclone-source) | none | Namespace of this Proxmox VE installation inside the repository. |
| [`rclone-replicate-from`](#rclone-replicate-from) | none | Local backup storages whose finished archives are replicated. Empty disables replication. |
| [`rclone-guests`](#rclone-guests) | `all` | Which guests are replicated: all, guests carrying one of rclone-tags, or rclone-vmids. |
| [`rclone-tags`](#rclone-tags) | `offsite` | Guest tags selecting guests when rclone-guests is "tagged". |
| [`rclone-vmids`](#rclone-vmids) | none | Guests replicated when rclone-guests is "listed". |
| [`rclone-exclude-vmids`](#rclone-exclude-vmids) | none | Guests never replicated. |
| [`rclone-backfill`](#rclone-backfill) | `latest` | Existing archives to replicate when replication is first enabled. |
| [`rclone-min-interval`](#rclone-min-interval) | `0` | Skip an archive if the guest already has an offsite backup newer than this (e.g. 7d). |
| [`rclone-supersede`](#rclone-supersede) | `1` | Drop queued, not yet started uploads of older archives of the same guest. |
| [`rclone-transfers`](#rclone-transfers) | `2` | Number of archives uploaded concurrently. |
| [`rclone-bwlimit`](#rclone-bwlimit) | none | Upload bandwidth limit in rclone syntax, optionally a timetable such as "08:00,1M 23:00,off". |
| [`rclone-segment-size`](#rclone-segment-size) | `1G` | Size of the segments archives are split into. |
| [`rclone-verify-interval`](#rclone-verify-interval) | `1d` | Interval of listing-based verification (presence and provider checksums). |
| [`rclone-verify-content`](#rclone-verify-content) | `off` | Interval of rolling download-based verification, or "off". |
| [`rclone-verify-budget`](#rclone-verify-budget) | `100G` | Maximum bytes downloaded per day for content verification. |
| [`rclone-min-age`](#rclone-min-age) | `7d` | Retention never deletes offsite backups younger than this. |
| [`rclone-keep-min`](#rclone-keep-min) | `1` | Retention keeps at least this many complete, verified backups per guest. |
| [`rclone-delete-grace`](#rclone-delete-grace) | `7d` | Deleted offsite backups are kept as tombstones for this long and can be restored. |
| [`rclone-max-deletes`](#rclone-max-deletes) | `25` | Maximum number of backups a single retention run may delete. |
| [`rclone-immutable`](#rclone-immutable) | `0` | Refuse every deletion of offsite backups. |

## `rclone-remote`

**Remote.** Name of the transport remote configured with 'pve-rclone-backup remote add'.

- Value: text matching the regular expression `[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}`.
- Default: none
- Required.

## `rclone-path`

**Repository Path.** Repository base path inside the remote: folder names separated by "/", of letters, digits, spaces, ".", "_" and "-", each starting with a letter or digit and not ending with a space.

- Value: text matching the regular expression `[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._ -]*[A-Za-z0-9._-])?(?:/[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._ -]*[A-Za-z0-9._-])?)*`, at most 128 characters.
- Default: `pve-backups`
- Set when the storage is created; it cannot be changed afterwards.

## `rclone-encryption`

**Encryption.** Client-side encryption of the repository (rclone crypt).

- Value: one of `crypt`, `none`.
- Default: `crypt`
- Set when the storage is created; it cannot be changed afterwards.

## `rclone-source`

**Source Name.** Namespace of this Proxmox VE installation inside the repository.

- Value: text matching the regular expression `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}`.
- Default: none
- Required. Set when the storage is created; it cannot be changed afterwards.

## `rclone-replicate-from`

**Replicate From.** Local backup storages whose finished archives are replicated. Empty disables replication.

- Value: a list of storage IDs, separated by commas, semicolons or spaces.
- Default: none

## `rclone-guests`

**Guests.** Which guests are replicated: all, guests carrying one of rclone-tags, or rclone-vmids.

- Value: one of `all`, `tagged`, `listed`.
- Default: `all`

## `rclone-tags`

**Tags.** Guest tags selecting guests when rclone-guests is "tagged".

- Value: a list of guest tags, separated by commas, semicolons or spaces.
- Default: `offsite`

## `rclone-vmids`

**Guest IDs.** Guests replicated when rclone-guests is "listed".

- Value: a list of guest IDs (VMIDs), separated by commas, semicolons or spaces.
- Default: none

## `rclone-exclude-vmids`

**Excluded Guest IDs.** Guests never replicated.

- Value: a list of guest IDs (VMIDs), separated by commas, semicolons or spaces.
- Default: none

## `rclone-backfill`

**Backfill.** Existing archives to replicate when replication is first enabled.

- Value: one of `none`, `latest`, `all`.
- Default: `latest`

## `rclone-min-interval`

**Minimum Interval.** Skip an archive if the guest already has an offsite backup newer than this (e.g. 7d).

- Value: a duration: a number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` or `w` (seconds to weeks), such as `7d`.
- Default: `0`

## `rclone-supersede`

**Supersede.** Drop queued, not yet started uploads of older archives of the same guest.

- Value: `1` (yes) or `0` (no).
- Default: `1`

## `rclone-transfers`

**Concurrent Uploads.** Number of archives uploaded concurrently.

- Value: an integer from 1 to 8.
- Default: `2`

## `rclone-bwlimit`

**Upload Bandwidth Limit.** Upload bandwidth limit in rclone syntax, optionally a timetable such as "08:00,1M 23:00,off".

- Value: text, at most 256 characters.
- Default: none

## `rclone-segment-size`

**Segment Size.** Size of the segments archives are split into.

- Value: a size in bytes with an optional binary unit `K`, `M`, `G` or `T`, such as `512M`, of at least `64M`.
- Default: `1G`

## `rclone-verify-interval`

**Verify Interval.** Interval of listing-based verification (presence and provider checksums).

- Value: a duration: a number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` or `w` (seconds to weeks), such as `7d`.
- Default: `1d`

## `rclone-verify-content`

**Content Verify Interval.** Interval of rolling download-based verification, or "off".

- Value: a duration: a number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` or `w` (seconds to weeks), such as `7d`, or `off`.
- Default: `off`

## `rclone-verify-budget`

**Content Verify Budget.** Maximum bytes downloaded per day for content verification.

- Value: a size in bytes with an optional binary unit `K`, `M`, `G` or `T`, such as `512M`.
- Default: `100G`

## `rclone-min-age`

**Minimum Age.** Retention never deletes offsite backups younger than this.

- Value: a duration: a number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` or `w` (seconds to weeks), such as `7d`.
- Default: `7d`

## `rclone-keep-min`

**Keep Minimum.** Retention keeps at least this many complete, verified backups per guest.

- Value: an integer of at least 0.
- Default: `1`

## `rclone-delete-grace`

**Delete Grace Period.** Deleted offsite backups are kept as tombstones for this long and can be restored.

- Value: a duration: a number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` or `w` (seconds to weeks), such as `7d`.
- Default: `7d`

## `rclone-max-deletes`

**Maximum Deletions.** Maximum number of backups a single retention run may delete.

- Value: an integer of at least 0.
- Default: `25`

## `rclone-immutable`

**Immutable.** Refuse every deletion of offsite backups.

- Value: `1` (yes) or `0` (no).
- Default: `0`

## Proxmox VE storage properties

The storage also accepts these properties that all Proxmox VE storages share.

| Property | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `content` | `backup`, the only content type of the storage. |
| `nodes` | Limits the storage to these nodes. Other nodes neither list its backups nor replicate to it. Unset means all nodes. |
| `disable` | `1` disables the storage: PVE does not use it and the daemon does not replicate to it. |
| `shared` | Always `1`, set automatically: every node reaches the same repository. |
| `prune-backups` | The offsite retention policy, in PVE's syntax (for example `keep-last=3,keep-weekly=4`). Unset keeps every backup. See [Retention](../guide/retention.md). |
| `max-protected-backups` | PVE's limit on protected backups per guest, applied when backups are protected through PVE. |
| `bwlimit` | PVE's bandwidth limits in KiB/s for operations PVE runs on the storage. Uploads are limited by `rclone-bwlimit` instead. |
